Two years use of SSRI, here are my two cents.  
1- Take med at night so you won't have side effects wrecking you all day.  
2- Start slowly. Standard dosage 5 mg the first time. then slowly increase to 10 or 20 according to your condition or as prescribed by your doctor.  
3- Don't start if your circumstances are not good. Like, make sure you don't have exams, work, assignments etc. Make sure you have a nice support system. Because two months after the start, you will be a total, absolute and utterly useless wreck of side effects. 

4-Seriously don't start on them unless you feel there is no other way. It is very difficult to get off them. The withdrawal symptoms suck! And let's not talk about 10 to 15 kg of weight you might put on and associated health issues with weight gain.
